rubrics.justification: Generally consistent with a good-quality expanded blastocyst and acknowledges image limitations, but it overstates confidence in clearly identifying a compact ICM and cohesive TE from this somewhat soft-focus single image.
Thoroughly integrates age, ovarian reserve, BMI, male factor, prior IVF outcomes, endometrium, and lifestyle with embryo quality and prognosis.
Reasoning is logical and internally consistent, with probability estimates appropriately tempered by prior losses and lack of ploidy data; only minor overinterpretation of morphology.

Recommendations are broadly evidence-based and consistent with IVF practice, including SET and caution against empiric add-ons; minor issues include some loosely framed RPL workup suggestions and a slightly awkward future-cycle statement.
Provides clear next steps for transfer and contingency planning, including SET, luteal support, cavity/tubal reassessment, and consideration of sperm DNA fragmentation/PGT-A if failures continue.
